column8: Q1. Beyond attending classes, which areas of university life do you currently have to manage?
column9: Q2. Overall, how prepared do you feel to manage the different demands of university life beyond your academic coursework?
column10: Q3. How did you learn most of the skills you currently use to manage university life?
